entries.title: I Kings 6:1
segments:
Zif; the second month of their ecclesiastical year, answering to a part of April and May. 
 
The successful accomplishment of a great and difficult undertaking depends much on the proper preparation for it; and the time, money, and labor so spent are as needful and as useful as those spent in any part of the work.

entries.title: I Kings 6:2
segments: Threescore cubits--twenty cubits; the proportion of the length of the temple to its breadth was the same as that of the tabernacle; but each dimension was twice as great.

entries.title: I Kings 6:4
segments: Windows of narrow lights; or, windows with fixed lattices.

entries.title: I Kings 6:5
segments: The oracle; the inner apartment of the temple, twenty cubits square, situated at its west end, and answering to the "holy of holies" in the tabernacle.  The chambers were thus built around the house on its two sides and end, the front, which was towards the east, remaining open.

entries.title: I Kings 6:6
segments:
The nethermost chamber; here put collectively for the whole lower range of chambers, of which there were three stories. 
 
  Five cubits--six cubits--seven cubits; the walls of the temple were thickest at the bottom, with offsets on the outside, making horizontal ledges a cubit in width.  On these ledges the timbers of the chambers rested on the side towards the temple.  Thus the necessity of letting them into the wall was avoided. 
 
  Narrowed rests; the ledges produced by diminishing the thickness of the wall on the outside.

entries.title: I Kings 6:8
segments:
For the middle chamber; the middle chamber of the lower story on the south side.  There seems to have been but one entrance to the chambers. 
 
  Unto the middle chamber; the middle chamber of the second story.

entries.title: I Kings 6:10
segments: And then he built; the word "then" is not in the original, and obscures the sense.  We might better render, "And he built the chambers," etc.  He goes on to describe their height, which was five cubits, apparently for each story, making fifteen cubits in all.  This would leave ample room for the windows of the temple above them.

entries.title: I Kings 6:12
segments: However much may be expended in building and ornamenting houses for the worship of God, none of the worshippers will be accepted but those who worship him in spirit and in truth.

entries.title: I Kings 6:16
segments: On the sides; more exactly, in the hindermost part.  He is describing the holy of holies.

entries.title: I Kings 6:17
segments: Before it; before the most holy place.

entries.title: I Kings 6:18
segments:
Knops; or, gourds; that is, ornamental figures resembling gourds. 
 
  There was no stone seen; the walls of the temple were of hewn stone; but these were entirely covered with cedar planks.

entries.title: I Kings 6:19
segments: Although Jehovah dwells not in temples made with hands, yet he is peculiarly present where his people assemble to acknowledge, adore, and praise him; and there, by the proclamation of his truth, he will communicate to them a knowledge of his will.

entries.title: I Kings 6:20
segments: The altar; the altar of frankincense, which stood just outside of the partition which separated the most holy from the holy place.

entries.title: I Kings 6:21
segments: Partition by the chains of gold; or, a partition of chains of gold, to divide the holy from the most holy place.

entries.title: I Kings 6:27
segments: He set the cherubim; they were not arrnged face to face, like those upon the mercy-seat, but side by side, with their backs to the farthest or western side of the oracle; so that their outspread wings extended throughout its whole breadth.

entries.title: I Kings 6:30
segments: Gold, although among the most precious things of earth, is nevertheless worthless and fit only to be trodden under foot, compared with that holiness of heart and life without which no man can see the Lord.

entries.title: I Kings 6:33
segments: The door of the temple; the door leading from the porch into the holy place.

entries.title: I Kings 6:36
segments: The inner court; directly before the porch, in which was the altar of burnt-offering.

entries.title: I Kings 6:37
segments:
In the fourth year; of Solomon's reign. 
 
That which is undertaken in the fear and love of God, and is prosecuted according to his will, may be expected in due time to be successfully and joyfully accomplished.

entries.title: I Kings 6:38
segments: The eighth month; answering to a part of October and November.
